LanguageData.WeazelGene_WeazelSyndrome.label: Weazel Syndrome
LanguageData.WeazelGene_WeazelSyndrome.description: Carriers feel pure euphoria from Essence extraction and live only for the next one.
LanguageData.WeazelGene_E_Cattle_Horny.label: Essence Domestication: Accelerated Breeding
LanguageData.WeazelGene_E_Cattle_Horny.description: The Weazels had completely lost it. There were countless uses for Essence, and nowhere near enough of it to go around.\nThen, a brilliant Weazel created this gene.\nIf they needed to extract more Essence, they would simply breed more of the livestock it could be extracted from.
